nodes.text: Colt crosses the quad to where Penelope is sitting...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey there, beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Eek! Burglar! `Burglar!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Eek! Burglar! [color=#3b78e2][i]Burglar![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I mean... Sorry, Colt. Reflex.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Understandable.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: What exactly are you doing here? If you're trying to make out with my new roommate, you can go right ahead. She's `way` gross.
nodes.text_bbcode: What exactly are you doing here? If you're trying to make out with my new roommate, you can go right ahead. She's [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] gross.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually... I'm here for you.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Wanna be my date to the Cotillion?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Oh! Colt! I'm flattered!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Actually... I'm mostly confused.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: But either way, I have to decline! I've already got a date! I'm going with Preston!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Preston? Please! I'm `way` hotter than that guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Preston? Please! I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] hotter than that guy!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: And if I were a shallow, materialistic shrew, that might be my sole criteria. However, seeing as I'm far more interested in a man's intellect and accomplishments... I'm going to have to go with Preston.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Accomplishments? Please. Does he even have a driver's license?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: If that's the only kind of accomplishment you can think of, then I rest my case.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I rest `my` case!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, I rest [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] case!

nodes.text: Colt turns and storms off.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: ...That really didn't make sense.
And so, Colt spends the next hour stalking around Monarch, asking out various girls...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Prissy! Looking foxy as ever!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Any chance I could interest you in being my date to the Cotillion?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Sure, you're free to try!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: To begin the application process, please provide me with your social security number, bank statement, proof of home ownership, and certification of status as a foreign monarch...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...I'm just going to walk away now.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: That's probably for the best.
And after that...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Madisenn! My main gal! Got a date to the Cotillion?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Oh no, sorry, Colt. I'm not going. Dances just stress me out too much...
And after `that...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And after [b]that...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Penelope! Hey again! You got the number of that gross new roommate?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Sorry, Colt, but she's got a date too.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on!
And soon enough, the sun has set...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dang! That's almost everyone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I wish I'd asked Paige... She probably would've said yes... But now there's no sign of her...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate to admit it... But it looks like I have only one option left...
Colt takes a deep breath...
And steps into Principal Whitford's office!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Mr. Warren! I heard rumors you were skulking around my school... But I never thought you'd have the audacity to walk straight into my office!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Whitford, I don't have a lot of energy or time left, so I'm just gonna cut right to the chase...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Would you be my date to the Spartan Cotillion?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Of course I would!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, really?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Yes, of course! It would provide me the perfect cover for spying on what my girls are up to!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually... I came here on kind of a long shot... I wasn't really expecting it to work...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: We'll need to give you a makeover, of course... A new haircut and a shave... And getting rid of those piercings wouldn't hurt...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Ooooh! I'm so excited I could squeal!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeeeeesh...
Looks like Colt is in way over his head... And we can't imagine how this is going to succeed at making Denni jealous!
Grossed out? Probably. Confused? Definitely. But jealous? Not a chance.
It looks like...
Colt walks over to where Paige is sitting.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey there, beautiful.
Paige glances up at Colt and smiles.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, well. If it isn't my favorite local badboy heartthrob. What're you doing here, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, I'm looking for you. How do you feel about being my date to the Cotillion?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ooo, a tempting offer... But I already have a date.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? Who's that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not that it's any of your business... But his name starts with a 'Ch' and ends in an 'ad'.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Chad? Please! I'm `way` hotter than that guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Chad? Please! I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] hotter than that guy!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's hard to argue with that... But unfortunately for you, the Cotillion is about much more than hotness.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I need a date who represents the promise of high-society... And that means a date who comes from a proper background and boasts sterling social connections.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Needless to say, Chad has you beat.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know, Paige, I might buy that from these other stuck-up goodie-two-shoes around here... But you? You want more out of your life than some boring humpty-dumpty rich guy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can see it in your eyes... There's a fire burning there!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I do like it when you compliment my eyes...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just picture your future with a guy like Chad, Paige. You'd have all the money in the world, sure... But you'd be bored out of your mind.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You'd lie by your dollar-sign-shaped pool all day and think about all the opportunities that could've been, wishing desperately for something to plug the aching hole in your heart.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow, that was... Incredibly poetic...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like that? It's a quote from this TV movie I saw the other day. Kind of a boring plot, but man the lead actress was hot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, either way, I'm sold.
Paige stands up and takes Colt's hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll meet you tonight at Spartan Academy?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's a date!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're a girl, Kim. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know her very well, but... You did leave Centerscore, you know? Did you call her or write her or anything like that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, no... It's not really my style...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So maybe she took that to mean you weren't interested in her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess I get that, but... Why come here? Why flirt with Mark Backbutter, of all people?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Maybe she's trying to hurt you.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: `Tom!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Tom![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, I mean it! If I were a girl, and I wanted to hurt some guy, I'd make sure he walked in on me hooking up with someone he hates!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Then I'd get a manicure... And go dress-shopping... Maybe buy a new purse...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Remind me why I make out with you again?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know what, I think he's right. Denni was flirting with Mark to make me jealous! It's the only explanation that makes sense!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Only one thing to do, right? Make her jealous back!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Seriously, Tom! Stop giving advice!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fancypants is right. If Denni's messing with my head, well, two can play that game! Except... With `her` head!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fancypants is right. If Denni's messing with my head, well, two can play that game! Except... With [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] head!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If she's gonna show up at the Craptillion with Mark... Then I'm going to show up with my own hot date!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I thought you were going stag...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not any more I'm not!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Even if I supported this plan, which I don't... The Cotillion is in just a few hours! How are you going to find a date in time?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The Den of the Immortals has an underground tunnel leading to Monarch Prep, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait, what? Since when? Why?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Have you used it, Tom?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Seriously, Colt, is there any part of `secret` society that you get?
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously, Colt, is there any part of [color=#e23b3b][i]secret[/i][/color] society that you get?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now then! I'll leave you two to your fighting or making out or whatever...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've gotta go find a date!
A short while later, Colt emerges from a sewer hatch onto the grounds of Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, gotta move fast... If that crazy Principal sees me, I'm done for.
Colt looks around. To the left, he sees Penelope resting under a tree, reading a book...
And to the right, he sees Paige texting on her cell phone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, think fast... Which one should I go for?

nodes.prompt: Which one should I go for?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Which one should I go for?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not saying we were 'Couple of the Year'... In fact, we may not have even been a couple...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: After what I went through in San Francisco, I even thought... You know... That we were going to be together.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But then she was dating this guy, Tweed, and now...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just don't get it. I thought I knew what kind of girl she was... But I never thought she'd straight do something like this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We kissed once, that's all. I don't have any real feelings for her!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Bull! You're `totally` into her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Bull! You're [color=#e23b3b][i]totally[/i][/color] into her!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I am not!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then look me in the eye and tell me that she wasn't a major part of why you went on your little journey of self-discovery!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... She might have been a `small` part...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... She might have been a [color=#e23b3b][i]small[/i][/color] part...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And tell me she's not a huge part of why you want to become a better man!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She's a factor, I'll admit...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Plus... And I didn't really want to go here... But you `totally` whisper her name in your sleep.
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus... And I didn't really want to go here... But you [color=#e23b3b][i]totally[/i][/color] whisper her name in your sleep.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I do?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh yeah. Usually it's all 'Step on the gas!' or 'Get the President to Air Force One...'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But every now and again, a 'Denni' slips out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Air Force One?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know, man, take it up with your subconscious.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Colt... If you have feelings for Denni... You can admit it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, fine. I care about her. I care about her `a lot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, fine. I care about her. I care about her [color=#e23b3b][i]a lot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I figured we might get together some day... But now... I don't feel like I even know her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean, why would she even do something like this?
Colt turns and storms out. Denni watches him go...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, I... I didn't mean to...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: ...You've got one crazy ex, you know that?
Outside, Colt storms across the Spartan quad to his dorm room. He throws it open...
To find Tom and Kim making out!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Whoa! Hey! Ever heard of knocking?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Seriously! Were you born in a barn?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Actually... That would explain a lot...
Colt storms over to his desk, kicking a chair on the way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just back off, okay? I didn't realize Kim would be here!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, Kim isn't exactly the Cotillion type, I thought I'd sneak her in for a little alone-time...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You make it sound `so` romantic...
nodes.text_bbcode: You make it sound [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] romantic...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, just give me a sec to grab some things, and I'll get out of your hair...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, you are `seriously` ticked off! What happened? Did you just find out about income tax?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, you are [color=#e23b3b][i]seriously[/i][/color] ticked off! What happened? Did you just find out about income tax?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Not now, Tom, he seems really upset...
Kim walks over and sits down on the foot of Colt's bed.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You are not going to believe who I ran into in the weight room...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The strong and reliable father figure you've always longed for?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Denni!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Denni? Like, Denni from Centerscore, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know a lot of other Denni's?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What was she doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, it `looked` like she was about to start making out with Mark Backbutter!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it [color=#e23b3b][i]looked[/i][/color] like she was about to start making out with Mark Backbutter!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Seriously? That guy? He sucks!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You and Denni... You had kind of a romantic thing going, right?
Colt winds up and delivers a devastating right hook to Mark's jaw! Mark lurches back, trips over the bench press and tumbles onto the floor.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: `Oooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oooof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's what I'm gonna do... `Punk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what I'm gonna do... [color=#e23b3b][i]Punk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! What is `wrong` with you?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt! What is [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong[/i][/color] with you?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's wrong with `me?` He shoved me first!
nodes.text_bbcode: What's wrong with [color=#e23b3b][i]me?[/i][/color] He shoved me first!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So? You `know` you're a better fighter than he is!
nodes.text_bbcode: So? You [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] you're a better fighter than he is!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You can't just solve all of your problems by punching them!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? Mark's jaw begs to differ!
On the ground, Mark tries to pull himself up, but isn't quite able...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See? Problem solved!
Denni hunkers down, resting a hand on Mark's shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mark, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I'm fine, just give me a second... Give me a second!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And that's all you care about, huh? If your precious new boyfriend is okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, you `did` just punch him in the face!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] just punch him in the face!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And for the record, he's not my...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, you know what? I don't care. I'm done with you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stay out of my life, okay? Forever.
Colt lets out a sharp hiss of air...
But doesn't throw the punch!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: What's wrong, little baby? Afraid to do the man dance?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I'm not afraid. I could take you in a heartbeat with one hand tied behind my back...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But you know what? I'm `better` than that. I'm better than you.
Colt turns to Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I'm better than `you.`

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, listen...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, `you` listen. I know things were never exactly rosy with us. I know we had our issues...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I never did anything like this.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You seriously wanna come to my new school without calling me and start fooling around with guys here? You can be my guest.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just do me a favor and stay out of my life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Forever.`
Colt presses his ear to the safe and spins the dial slowly...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Almost there... One click... Another click... And...
Colt presses the dial just the tiniest bit... And the safe swings open!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Clickety-clack! Who's the man? `I'm` the man!
nodes.text_bbcode: Clickety-clack! Who's the man? [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the man!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well-done, Hades!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Well, I have to admit... You are good for at least one thing...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which puts me two up on you. Now come on, let's get this goofshow on the road.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Stop it, Colt! You're not helping the situation!
Colt spins around.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, you do `not` get to tell me how to do things, Princess! You're the reason I'm in this mess to begin with!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] get to tell me how to do things, Princess! You're the reason I'm in this mess to begin with!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Excuse` me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Excuse[/i][/color] me?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you hadn't been making out with Mark Frikkin' Backbutter, I would've stuck by my pledge to be a better man and never cracked that stupid safe!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, first off, we were not making out...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Semantic.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And second, how `dare` you try to blame me for your moral lapses?
nodes.text_bbcode: And second, how [color=#3b78e2][i]dare[/i][/color] you try to blame me for your moral lapses?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did I `make` you join the Immortals?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did I [color=#3b78e2][i]make[/i][/color] you join the Immortals?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you did as a matter of fact, when you started dating Tweed!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I only started dating Ben because `you` ran off on your stupid spirit journey!
nodes.text_bbcode: I only started dating Ben because [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] ran off on your stupid spirit journey!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which I only did because `you` kissed me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Which I only did because [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I kissed `you?` No way, buddy, you kissed me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]you?[/i][/color] No way, buddy, you kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Guys, while I'm sure this version of the blame game could take us all the way back to the Big Bang, maybe we should try to focus on getting out of here...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Plus, is anyone else impressed Colt knew the word 'semantic'? I know I am!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut up, Fancypants! You're just as guilty as Denni is!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I never would've even wanted to join Percy's stupid society if it wasn't for you!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, Colt, you're absolutely right. I `should` have known that our entire initiation into the society was an elaborate ploy to get us to break into a safe and steal some tests.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, Colt, you're absolutely right. I [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] have known that our entire initiation into the society was an elaborate ploy to get us to break into a safe and steal some tests.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! You should have! What good is that big, fancy brain of yours if it can't figure out an obvious trap?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, maybe I would've figured it out, if you'd given me a few minutes to think instead of lumbering towards that safe like some kind of gorilla!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Guys, `please!` Let's all just stop attacking each other! None of us is really at fault...
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys, [color=#e23b3b][i]please![/i][/color] Let's all just stop attacking each other! None of us is really at fault...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, you're one to talk, Nick! If you hadn't bumped into the door and given away our position, we would've gotten away with the whole thing on video!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Some journalist `you` turned out to be!
nodes.text_bbcode: Some journalist [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] turned out to be!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, you did `not` just call out my journalistic cred!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you did [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] just call out my journalistic cred!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I did.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, if you're such a great journalist, why didn't you realize your secret crush or whatever was being played for an idiot by the Immortals?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ugh!
Everyone stomps off to a different corner of the room, and they stand there, glaring at each other...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... This sucks.
We know Denni and Colt's relationship began with them trapped in a room... But who knew it would end the same way?
Try again, and see what you can do differently!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Seriously? Are you telling me you've never cheated on a test?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... Not recently...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: You cheated off my math test last week!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, sure, I copied an answer or two, but, you know... There's cheating, and then there's `cheating.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, sure, I copied an answer or two, but, you know... There's cheating, and then there's [color=#e23b3b][i]cheating.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Heh, you sound just like my step-mom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gross.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Spare me the ethical ramblings, Colt. The only difference here is scale, which your puny mind obviously can't comprehend.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You really think there's nothing wrong with what you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: There is no right or wrong! Morality is a false construct of the weak, created to impose restrictions on the strong!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, that got existential...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Seriously...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I don't care how bleak your world-view is. We are `not` gonna let you do this. It's just plain wrong.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I don't care how bleak your world-view is. We are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] gonna let you do this. It's just plain wrong.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And this coming from the boy who spent five months in a juvenile correction center?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: First off, stay out of my records, jerk.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And second, yeah, maybe I used to be the kind of guy who'd do a thing like this...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I'm a different man now. A `better` man.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I'm a different man now. A [color=#e23b3b][i]better[/i][/color] man.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe I don't always follow the law... But I try to do the right thing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And helping a bunch of snobby rich boys get away with something like this... Well, that's as wrong as it gets.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh my! What a rousing speech! I'm so impressed, I practically fell asleep!
Colt steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen here, Shaggy Bottoms... I am `not` letting you do this.
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen here, Shaggy Bottoms... I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] letting you do this.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt! Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, Fancypants...
Colt steps over to stand by the rest of the Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I'm an Immortal for life.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No! Why?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, what do you mean why? These guys just guaranteed me automatic good grades! Do you know how easy that'll make everything?
Percy claps his hand on Colt's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Good grades are just the beginning of it, my economically-challenged friend!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You'll get power... Money... Opportunities wilder than you could ever imagine...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Not to mention crazy-hot girls!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I `love` crazy-hot girls!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] crazy-hot girls!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What about Denni?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What `about` her? She made her choice... And I'm making mine.
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#e23b3b][i]about[/i][/color] her? She made her choice... And I'm making mine.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You `know` they're just using you, right? You'll be their henchman! Their stooge! Their... Their serf!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] they're just using you, right? You'll be their henchman! Their stooge! Their... Their serf!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, `surf's` up.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah? Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]surf's[/i][/color] up.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That doesn't even make sense!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Enough with this buffoon! Are you ready to help us take `The Immortals` to glorious new heights?
nodes.text_bbcode: Enough with this buffoon! Are you ready to help us take [color=#e23b3b][i]The Immortals[/i][/color] to glorious new heights?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I am!
Meanwhile, just outside, Denni and Nick sit hidden, taping the whole thing...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wow, that's... That's rough.
Denni takes the camera out of Nick's hands...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It is... And I can't release it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What are you talking about? We just got proof of The Immortal's corruption! We can take them all down!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Exactly... We'd be destroying Colt! I can't do that to him!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You heard what he said, Denni... He made his choice.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know, but... I still care about him...
Nick reaches over and takes Denni's hands.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know you do. You'll probably always care about him...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But if we don't release this footage, we'll be just as guilty as he is. We'll be doing the wrong thing... And we'll be letting The Immortals win.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They've taken your friend's soul... Don't let them take yours.
Denni sighs deeply... Then hands back the camera.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay. You're right.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Come on. Let's get out of here.
Nick and Denni start to walk away. Denni shoots one last glance over her shoulder and feels one last pang of guilt... But then keeps walking.
It's too late...
Colt presses his ear to the safe and spins the dial slowly...
But nothing happens!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grrr! Come on!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Don't tell me you can't do this!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I `can` do it, okay, it's just been a while!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] do it, okay, it's just been a while!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How often do you crack safes?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me just try again...
Colt spins the dial again... To no avail!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Unbelievable! I was sure you'd be good for `something!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Unbelievable! I was sure you'd be good for [color=#e23b3b][i]something![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Perhaps we can deduce the combo through `brute force...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Perhaps we can deduce the combo through [color=#e23b3b][i]brute force...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm on it!
Chad lumbers over and smashes his foot into the safe!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: That's not what I...
The safe swings open with a creak!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Meant?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Brute force, baby, brute force! That is how I `roll!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Brute force, baby, brute force! That is how I [color=#e23b3b][i]roll![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well, I hate to admit it, but you do appear to have proven your worth today...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Unlike Colt!
Just then, Colt's phone beeps. He flips it open and reads the text...

nodes.speaker: Text
nodes.text: Immortals. It's time. Meet out in the quad ASAP.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Guess it's go-time.
Colt grabs a last appetizer, shoves it in his pocket, and heads outside.
He doesn't notice Nick signaling across the room to Denni...
Colt heads out to the Quad, where the other Immortals are gathered.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: There you are! I figured you wouldn't show!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Luckily for us, you're wrong about everything. Now what's this big thing we're doing? Tell me it involves punching someone...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I oughta punch you for my stealing my date...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Now, now. What we're here for doesn't involve violence... But it is very much against the rules.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Follow me.
Percy leads the Immortals towards the administration building. As they walk, Tom sidles up next to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey there. Guessing it didn't go too well with Paige?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See me get slapped?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh yeah.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ahem! Every year, at the end of the Cotillion, The Immortals throw a fireworks show for the girls from Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Girls `love` fireworks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Girls [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Unfortunately, this year, our oh-so-helpful administration decided that they didn't want the liability... So they confiscated all of our fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, this town is crazy obsessed with fireworks...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Of course, we Immortals are never deterred by such boorish tactics...
Percy walks to the door of the Headmaster's office and throws it open. The guys step inside...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Which is why we're going to steal them back!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You in?
For a moment, Colt remembers his decision to be a better man...
Then he remembers Denni, seated on the bench, Mark's arm around her waist.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Point me to 'em.
Percy grins and walks across the room to a huge, metal floor-safe.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: They're all in here... The safe where Headmaster Moriarty keeps all confiscated contraband.
Tom cocks his head to the side.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why would the Headmaster keep contraband in a safe branded 'California Department of Education'?
The Immortals all look nervously at each other...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Because... The Department of Education... Collects it?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Exactly! That's what happened! Now let's get it open already!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me guess... None of you rich-boys know the first thing about cracking a safe, do you?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I know about competitively shopping for one...
Colt sighs and sidles up to the safe, turning the dial and pressing his ear against it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The key is to listen for `clicks,` `clacks,` and `clickety-clacks!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The key is to listen for [color=#e23b3b][i]clicks,[/i][/color] [color=#e23b3b][i]clacks,[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]clickety-clacks![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's just... This girl, Denni... We kind of had this weird chemistry going for a while...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But first I was dating someone... Then she was dating someone... Then... Then it got all weird. Now it just seems like she's messing with my head and trying to rile me up and... It's all bad times.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I never thought I'd be the kind of guy to get all worked up over a girl...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I guess... Here I am.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... I don't know `all` the details of your problem...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I don't know [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] the details of your problem...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why would you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I have to say... Isn't it possible you're not totally understanding the situation?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I mean, this girl... Maybe she has a really good reason for the way she's acting...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: A reason you can't understand now... But will... In time...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... I guess that's possible...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean, Denni is a complicated girl...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, she is...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Or so... I'd imagine...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...You're a pretty weird dude, Captain Emo.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You sure? I can be a pretty good listener...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, man, spare me the comforting waiter act, okay?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Is that a thing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, why else would you be trying to talk to me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because... I could be helpful?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I don't know if this is some weird emo thing, but I guarantee you that you don't know the first thing about me or my situation.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So do me a big favor and keep your helpful advice to yourself!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know what? Fine.
Nick turns to walk away...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Buddy! I wasn't done eating!
Nick sighs and turns around. Colt resumes bingeing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mmm... I like how's it bacon, but also steak.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: May I recommend the quiche?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't do quiche.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...No, I don't suppose you do.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And what, `exactly,` was that?
nodes.text_bbcode: And what, [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly,[/i][/color] was that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't play dumb, Colt. There's `obviously` something going with you and that hipster girl.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't play dumb, Colt. There's [color=#3b78e2][i]obviously[/i][/color] something going with you and that hipster girl.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's... It's nothing, okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't like being strung along. If you have something else going on, you should let me know.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't have anything else going on! Why do you have to be so nosy, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...'Denni?'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean... Paige...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Unbelievable... You just asked me out to make that girl jealous, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's... Not entirely accurate... I mean, you are pretty hot...
Paige recoils for a moment... Then slaps Colt across the face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't care how hot or exciting you are...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one... `No one...` Uses me. Get out of my sight.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one... [color=#3b78e2][i]No one...[/i][/color] Uses me. Get out of my sight.

nodes.text: Paige turns and storms off.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yup. I pretty much deserved that.
Dejected, Colt makes his way to the buffet table...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hors d'oeuvre?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Naw, man, I'm not into that...
Nick offers up a tray of bacon-wrapped filet mignon.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It means 'appetizer'.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then yes.
Colt shovels several into his mouth.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh man, these are really good...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... Looks like you had a little trouble out on the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Oh, with the girls? Yeah, that... That sucked.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... Um... Wanna talk to me about it?
Colt throws a punch at Mark's head...
But he catches it in his opened palm!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Did you really think you were gonna get me with the same right hook twice?
So quickly no one else can see, Mark pulls Colt in close and delivers a lightning-fast jab to Colt's abdomen!
Colt's nostrils flare, his fist clenches and unclenches...
But he holds back and does not strike.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Backbutter, you think I don't see what you're up to?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There's nothing that would make you happier than to see me get thrown out of here for making a scene.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, hombre. Not gonna happen.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: ...Whatever, man. You're just too much of a pansy to throw down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wow. You're a walking, talking cliche aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Denni, if this is seriously the kind of guy you want to be with, be my guest.
Colt wraps his arm around Paige's waist.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Me? I prefer a classier kind of girl.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you'll excuse us... We've got some fancy dancing to do.
Colt and Paige drift away from Denni and Mark...
A little while later, Colt stands in his room while Tom helps him with his bow tie...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Well, I have to admit, Colt, you cut quite a dashing figure in your tux...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I feel like a friggin' penguin...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Maybe, but you'll be a penguin that Paige won't be able to keep her hands off of!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Not to be the voice of reason or anything, but are you `sure` you want to go through with this, Colt? If Denni still has feelings for you, it might just make things worse.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not to be the voice of reason or anything, but are you [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] you want to go through with this, Colt? If Denni still has feelings for you, it might just make things worse.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni made her feelings pretty clear when she cozied up to Mark. I'm just returning the favor.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Besides, Paige is `really` hot.
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, Paige is [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] hot.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, like crazy.
Kim elbows Tom in the side.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now, apparently, you two have this big, stupid, exclusive dance to get to, so I'll just get going...
Kim leans forward and gives Tom a kiss.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Love you. Have fun.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Cheat on me, and you're a dead man!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Duly noted!
Kim walks out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She's a real firecracker, huh?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: She's something special.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now listen! I know you're probably going to be playing out your little drama with Denni tonight... But don't forget that we're supposed to meet with the Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I remember. Sneak out to the quad for some top-secret activity.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You'd think the point of being in a secret society is that you get to be `in` on the secrets...
nodes.text_bbcode: You'd think the point of being in a secret society is that you get to be [color=#e23b3b][i]in[/i][/color] on the secrets...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ours is not to question why, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now, come on! Let's get to the dance!
A few minutes later, Colt strolls into the deluxe ballroom at the edge of Spartan. It's packed with dancing couples!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dude! This place is `crazy` nice!
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude! This place is [color=#e23b3b][i]crazy[/i][/color] nice!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Colt! There you are!
Colt turns around to see Paige approaching.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey there!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, well, look at this. Who would've thought you'd fill out a tux so elegantly?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I didn't know better, I'd think you were actually a proper gentleman!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And if `I` didn't know better, I'd think you cared.
nodes.text_bbcode: And if [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] didn't know better, I'd think you cared.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Touche. Dance?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My pleasure.
Colt takes Paige's hand. They drift together onto the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aren't you full of surprises? Where'd you learn to dance like this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My little sister was really into it for a while. I had to learn just to keep up.
Colt and Paige gently twirl through the throng of students...
And bump right into Mark and Denni!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ooof!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! And... A very pretty girl!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni, meet Paige. Paige, meet Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, I... I didn't think you'd have a date, I... We need to talk...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, I don't know who you think you are or what you're doing here, but you need to back off my date, freakshow. `Now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, I don't know who you think you are or what you're doing here, but you need to back off my date, freakshow. [color=#3b78e2][i]Now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, there's no need to get so hostile, Paige...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't tell me you have a history with this weirdo!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: A history is `all` he has... Because he's going to back off now and never talk to her again!
nodes.text_bbcode: A history is [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] he has... Because he's going to back off now and never talk to her again!

nodes.text: Mark steps away from Denni, getting right up in Colt's face...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Ain't that right, `Poorboy?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ain't that right, [color=#e23b3b][i]Poorboy?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You son-of-a...

menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: They stand together by the shore of the lake. Denni wraps her arms around Colt's waist and holds him close...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Promise me you'll never run away again?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll never leave your side, Princess.
The bushes around them part, and dozens of police officers burst out!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What... In the name... Of great Caeser's ghost...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Is going on here?!
Colt and Denni look at each other and smile...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's kind of a long story, Officer...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But for starters... We've got this video that you probably ought to see!
Wow! You took down the Immortals, cleared Colt's name, `and` finally got him and Denni together! Talk about an amazing ending!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow! You took down the Immortals, cleared Colt's name, [b]and[/b] finally got him and Denni together! Talk about an amazing ending!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Colt winds up and delivers a brutal right hook to Percy's jaw! Percy falls back into the bushes and lies there, knocked out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My name... Is `Colt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: My name... Is [color=#e23b3b][i]Colt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow... How'd that feel?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really good! Like, really, `really` good!
nodes.text_bbcode: Really good! Like, really, [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] good!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Kinda hurt my knuckles, though...
Denni takes Colt's hand and gently kisses his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All better?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All better.
Colt panics and freezes up...
And Denni decks Percy with a swift right hook! He crumples back into the bushes and lies there, knocked out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: His name is `Colt!`
Denni grins and then shakes her hand painfully.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ow! Punching people `really` hurts!
Colt takes her hand and gently kisses each knuckle.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How's that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All better.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Agggggggh!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ahhhhhhhh!
Colt and Denni slide under the helicopter at an almost horizontal angle, shooting up a fine mist of dirt...
And they pull themselves upright on the other side!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.text: Go, Colt, go!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Uh oh.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `Aiiiiie!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aiiiiie![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Percy hurls himself out of the cockpit into the lake! The helicopter crashes nose-first into the path and goes up in a massive explosion!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We did it! We `did` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: We did it! We [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] it!

nodes.text: Colt looks back at her and grins...
And that's when a stray piece of debris hits the bike's rear tire.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh `crap!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh [color=#e23b3b][i]crap![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The bike jerks and spins out of control! Colt tries to stabilize it, but it skids out, sending him and Denni flying!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt's head hits the ground...
For a moment, everything goes dark and still...
Then he opens his eyes again. His bike is on its side, tires still spinning. Behind him, the ruin of the helicopter pops and crackles...
And a few feet away, Denni lies on the ground, her eyes shut, not moving.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh no. No no `no!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. No no [color=#e23b3b][i]no![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Even though his whole body aches, Colt forces himself up. He crawls frantically towards Denni, grabs her, and turns her to face him...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni! Please! Say something!
Very slowly, her eyes flutter open...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni! Are you hurt?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, Colt... I'm fine. I'm okay.
Colt looks down at Denni's face, illuminated by the bright dancing flames of the fire behind them...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No. You're more than okay.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're the most beautiful thing I've ever held in my arms.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...
And then they kiss, passionately, deeply. Behind them, the helicopter goes up in one final, triumphant burst of light and heat.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. Wow.
Colt helps Denni up to her feet and gently holds her hand. Sirens wail in the distance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, what do you think? This gonna make a good story for the newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? This is going to be the biggest story this town has ever...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `You!` You ruined everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You![/i][/color] You ruined everything!

nodes.text: Colt and Denni spin around to see Percy standing right behind them! He's soaking wet from head-to-toe and caked in mud!
He reaches out towards them with a trembling hand.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I will destroy you, Hades!
He has failed.

Colt and Denni streak towards the helicopter! Behind the controls, Percy's mouth goes wide with horror!

Then tosses it into the lake!

nodes.speaker: Denni

nodes.text: Ha! Yes! I win! `I win!`
Percy jerks his helicopter down again! This time, the blast of air is strong enough to knock over the bike, sending Colt and Denni toppling into the dirt!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Good night, losers!
Percy lifts off and flies away into the night. Colt and Denni slowly pick themselves up out of the dirt...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why, Colt? Why? We might have been able to get by him...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...I just couldn't risk it. You gotta understand...
Colt looks into Denni's eyes, and in them, he sees the truth...
Colt swerves at the last second, weaving around the log...
And Chad crashes right into it with a hard, metal crunch!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoa!
Colt revs the engine, speeding off deeper into the woods!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is Chad going to be okay?
From behind them, they can hear a voice shout...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Get back here at once!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: His body? Sure. His ego? Well, that took a bruising!
Colt and Denni clear the tree line and come to a gentle stop alongside the shore of Lake Centerscore. A small, narrow path runs along the coast, leading up to downtown Centerscore beyond it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As for us... Not to jinx it... But I think we're home free!
Suddenly, a hot white light blasts them from above! Colt looks up and sees a helicopter in the night sky above them!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No!
The helicopter descends, its whirling rotors blowing gusts of wind along the waterfront! It hovers directly over the path, ten feet above the ground, blocking their way. And behind the controls is...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Nice try, street rats, but your merry little chase ends here!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course he has a helicopter! Why wouldn't he have a helicopter?!
Percy jerks the helicopter down, shooting a hard blast of air in their direction! The motorcycle wobbles but doesn't fall!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's crazy!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No... He's just a guy against the wall with everything to lose... And that makes him more dangerous than anything else!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Enough with the tomfoolery, Hades! Just toss the DigiVid card into the lake, and we can all be on our way!
The whole world seems to go still for one moment. Denni leans in close to Colt's ear and whispers...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are we going to do?
Colt tightens his grip on the handlebars.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You trust me?
Denni clutches her arms around Colt's waist.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: With my life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then let's roll!
He has failed.

nodes.text: Ugh! That was possibly the worst experience of my life! There were spiders as big as my head!

nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.text: So we can alter them, you idiot. With just a little creative doctoring, why, everyone in this school will pass their SETs with flying colors... And Spartan Academy will preserve its sterling academic reputation!

nodes.text: Of course! How do you think Ares here got a perfect verbal score?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm basically illiterate!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This doesn't make sense. I mean, the school has to know something's up...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You still don't get it, do you? The administration is in on it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: This way, Spartan gets all the fancy endowments for top-performing schools!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Did you really think the administration would let an organization like The Immortals thrive without a price? We doctor the tests for them... And they give us all the luxuries we want!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Of course, this year, the Department of Education got suspicious and made the school store the tests in their personal safe...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Which is precisely where Colt came into the picture.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...I see how it is. You saw the poor kid with the criminal background and figured, well, he's `gotta` know how to crack a safe!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...I see how it is. You saw the poor kid with the criminal background and figured, well, he's [color=#e23b3b][i]gotta[/i][/color] know how to crack a safe!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Was I mistaken?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And yet, even in this one regard, you somehow managed to disappoint.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, I appreciate helping the school, but I can't get behind this... It completely violates the spirit of free competition!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh, spare me the pious act! Didn't you bribe your way out of the entirety of eighth grade?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I was a different guy back then. I'm not that kind of person anymore...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And neither is Colt.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Why don't you let your blue-collar friend speak for himself.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: What do you say, Colt? Are you with Tom... Or with us?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Seriously? You guys are doing this macho crap again?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They were doing this before? Colt, what is the meaning of this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just... Give me a sec... To catch my breath...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: There's a lot more where that came from, punk. Now stay away from my girl!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, I...
But it's too late. Mark grabs Denni by the hand and drags her off.
Paige watches them go, and then turns to Colt angrily.
A short while later, Colt emerges from a sewer hatch onto the grounds of Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, gotta move fast... If that crazy Principal sees me, I'm done for.
Colt looks around. To the left, he sees Penelope resting under a tree, reading a book...
And to the right, he sees Paige texting on her cell phone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, think fast... Which one should I go for?

nodes.prompt: Which one should I go for?

menu.text: Which one should I go for?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, I appreciate helping the school, but I can't get behind this... It completely violates the spirit of free competition!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh, spare me the pious act! Didn't you bribe your way out of the entirety of eighth grade?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I was a different guy back then. I'm not that kind of person anymore...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And neither is Colt.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Why don't you let your blue-collar friend speak for himself.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: What do you say, Colt? Are you with Tom... Or with us?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Stop it, Colt! You're not helping the situation!
Colt spins around.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, you do `not` get to tell me how to do things, Princess! You're the reason I'm in this mess to begin with!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] get to tell me how to do things, Princess! You're the reason I'm in this mess to begin with!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Excuse` me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Excuse[/i][/color] me?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you hadn't been making out with Mark Frikkin' Backbutter, I would've stuck by my pledge to be a better man and never cracked that stupid safe!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, first off, we were not making out...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Semantic.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And second, how `dare` you try to blame me for your moral lapses?
nodes.text_bbcode: And second, how [color=#3b78e2][i]dare[/i][/color] you try to blame me for your moral lapses?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did I `make` you join the Immortals?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did I [color=#3b78e2][i]make[/i][/color] you join the Immortals?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you did as a matter of fact, when you started dating Tweed!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I only started dating Ben because `you` ran off on your stupid spirit journey!
nodes.text_bbcode: I only started dating Ben because [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] ran off on your stupid spirit journey!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which I only did because `you` kissed me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Which I only did because [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I kissed `you?` No way, buddy, you kissed me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]you?[/i][/color] No way, buddy, you kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Guys, while I'm sure this version of the blame game could take us all the way back to the Big Bang, maybe we should try to focus on getting out of here...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Plus, is anyone else impressed Colt knew the word 'semantic'? I know I am!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut up, Fancypants! You're just as guilty as Denni is!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I never would've even wanted to join Percy's stupid society if it wasn't for you!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, Colt, you're absolutely right. I `should` have known that our entire initiation into the society was an elaborate ploy to get us to break into a safe and steal some tests.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, Colt, you're absolutely right. I [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] have known that our entire initiation into the society was an elaborate ploy to get us to break into a safe and steal some tests.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! You should have! What good is that big, fancy brain of yours if it can't figure out an obvious trap?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, maybe I would've figured it out, if you'd given me a few minutes to think instead of lumbering towards that safe like some kind of gorilla!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Guys, `please!` Let's all just stop attacking each other! None of us is really at fault...
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys, [color=#e23b3b][i]please![/i][/color] Let's all just stop attacking each other! None of us is really at fault...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, you're one to talk, Nick! If you hadn't bumped into the door and given away our position, we would've gotten away with the whole thing on video!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Some journalist `you` turned out to be!
nodes.text_bbcode: Some journalist [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] turned out to be!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, you did `not` just call out my journalistic cred!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you did [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] just call out my journalistic cred!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I did.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, if you're such a great journalist, why didn't you realize your secret crush or whatever was being played for an idiot by the Immortals?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ugh!
Everyone stomps off to a different corner of the room, and they stand there, glaring at each other...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... This sucks.
We know Denni and Colt's relationship began with them trapped in a room... But who knew it would end the same way?
Try again, and see what you can do differently!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh really? And how exactly do you plan to...
Suddenly, Percy is cut off by a clattering sound from behind him!
Everyone spins around... To see Denni and Nick hidden behind the doorway! Nick is taping the whole affair through a fancy digital video camera!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What the...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Surprise office inspection?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `Grab them!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Grab them![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick and Denni turn to run, but Carson and Chad are too fast! The two guys catch them and pull them into the room!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ooof!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't you touch her!
Colt lunges forward, but Percy elbows him in the gut!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oof!
Colt tumbles to the ground! Tom kneels to help him, and Percy kicks him in the shoulder, sending him sprawling as well!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Aggh!
The other Immortals toss Nick and Denni forward! They spill onto the ground in front of Colt and Tom!
Colt kneels down, helping Denni up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni! You okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm fine...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Don't even think about fighting. You'd never take the five of us!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...He's right.
Percy kneels down and takes the video camera out of Nick's hand.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ah, Nicolas Brown. Our school's intrepid reporter. Tell me, did you get that whole thing on video?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just about.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Then you came so, `so` close to finally cracking your case.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then you came so, [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] close to finally cracking your case.

nodes.text: Percy grins, and then smashes the camera against the desk, shattering it into a dozen pieces!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And now... Your cell phones, please? And don't try resisting, because we `will` just take them with force.
nodes.text_bbcode: And now... Your cell phones, please? And don't try resisting, because we [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] just take them with force.

nodes.text: Chad walks forward and collects everyone's cell phones.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You won't get away with this!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Of course we will! You don't have any proof... And who would possibly take your word against ours?
Percy grabs the remaining tests from the safe.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Now then. We've got a long night of test-doctoring ahead of us. You four just stay here and take it easy, would you?
Percy and the other Immortals back away. As they step out the door, Percy turns to Chad...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Block the door with something heavy, would you?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: My pleasure.
The door slams shut. There is the sound of something heavy being pressed against it... And then the sound of laughter and footsteps departing.
Colt runs over and tries the door! It opens an inch, and then hits a bookshelf!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grrr! Come `on!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrr! Come [color=#e23b3b][i]on![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoa!
Colt's bike blasts down a bumpy dirt path! Trees fly by at breakneck speed!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are... You... Sure... About... This?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure as I... Can be!
Colt glances over his shoulder to see Chad following right behind! His car scrapes against trees and rocks, but he doesn't slow down!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He's like a bug that just won't die!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! Look out!
Colt looks up... To see a fallen log directly in his path!
Colt and Denni clear the tree line and come to a gentle stop alongside the shore of Lake Centerscore. A small, narrow path runs along the coast, leading up to downtown Centerscore beyond it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As for us... Not to jinx it... But I think we're home free!
Suddenly, a hot white light blasts them from above! Colt looks up and sees a helicopter in the night sky above them!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No!
The helicopter descends, its whirling rotors blowing gusts of wind along the waterfront! It hovers directly over the path, ten feet above the ground, blocking their way. And behind the controls is...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Nice try, street rats, but your merry little chase ends here!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course he has a helicopter! Why wouldn't he have a helicopter?!
Percy jerks the helicopter down, shooting a hard blast of air in their direction! The motorcycle wobbles but doesn't fall!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's crazy!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No... He's just a guy against the wall with everything to lose... And that makes him more dangerous than anything else!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Enough with the tomfoolery, Hades! Just toss the DigiVid card into the lake, and we can all be on our way!
The whole world seems to go still for one moment. Denni leans in close to Colt's ear and whispers...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are we going to do?
Colt tightens his grip on the handlebars.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You trust me?
Denni clutches her arms around Colt's waist.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: With my life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then let's roll!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Agggggggh!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ahhhhhhhh!
Colt and Denni slide under the helicopter at an almost horizontal angle, shooting up a fine mist of dirt...
And they pull themselves upright on the other side!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: No!
Colt floors it, and the bike races off down the path!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Go, Colt, go!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]NO!!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Percy jerks his helicopter around... But the rear rotors catch on a chunk of tree line!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Uh oh.
The helicopter spins wildly out of control, and then jerks down towards the ground!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `Aiiiiie!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aiiiiie![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Percy hurls himself out of the cockpit into the lake! The helicopter crashes nose-first into the path and goes up in a massive explosion!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We did it! We `did` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: We did it! We [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] it!

nodes.text: Colt looks back at her and grins...
And that's when a stray piece of debris hits the bike's rear tire.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh `crap!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh [color=#e23b3b][i]crap![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The bike jerks and spins out of control! Colt tries to stabilize it, but it skids out, sending him and Denni flying!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt's head hits the ground...
For a moment, everything goes dark and still...
Then he opens his eyes again. His bike is on its side, tires still spinning. Behind him, the ruin of the helicopter pops and crackles...
And a few feet away, Denni lies on the ground, her eyes shut, not moving.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh no. No no `no!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. No no [color=#e23b3b][i]no![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Even though his whole body aches, Colt forces himself up. He crawls frantically towards Denni, grabs her, and turns her to face him...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni! Please! Say something!
Very slowly, her eyes flutter open...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni! Are you hurt?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, Colt... I'm fine. I'm okay.
Colt looks down at Denni's face, illuminated by the bright dancing flames of the fire behind them...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No. You're more than okay.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're the most beautiful thing I've ever held in my arms.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...
And then they kiss, passionately, deeply. Behind them, the helicopter goes up in one final, triumphant burst of light and heat.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. Wow.
Colt helps Denni up to her feet and gently holds her hand. Sirens wail in the distance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, what do you think? This gonna make a good story for the newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? This is going to be the biggest story this town has ever...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `You!` You ruined everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You![/i][/color] You ruined everything!

nodes.text: Colt and Denni spin around to see Percy standing right behind them! He's soaking wet from head-to-toe and caked in mud!
He reaches out towards them with a trembling hand.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I will destroy you, Hades!
Colt has failed.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on tight, Princess... Town Hall is about ten minutes away, and I'm gonna make it in seven...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, Colt... You might want to make it five!
Colt glances over his shoulder... And sees a bright red convertible gaining on them! Chad sits behind the wheel, a furious look on his face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This night just keeps getting better and better...
Chad floors it! His car races towards the bike!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We need to lose him!
Colt swerves his bike off the road and...
He slams it a few more times, but it doesn't budge! He's about to slam his whole body into it when a soft hand touches his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't bother, Colt. They've got us trapped.
Colt turns around and looks at Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni, I... I don't understand. What's going on? Why were you and Captain Emo taping us?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We knew The Immortals were up to something... And when we realized what, we knew we had to get proof!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, I get that, but... Why were you at Spartan in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Because I was worried about you, Colt! I knew you'd gotten mixed up in something bad at Spartan, and I needed to make sure you were okay!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know you told me you didn't want to see me again in that email, but I just had to ignore it and...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, slow down, Princess. `What` email?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, slow down, Princess. [color=#e23b3b][i]What[/i][/color] email?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The... The one you sent yesterday... The one where you said you wanted me to stay out of your life?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni, I never sent you an email. I haven't even checked my email in, like, a month and a half.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But then... How...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Someone must have hacked your account!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Percy. It had to be. Just another reason to pound his stupid face in...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...So you never told me off? You `don't` want me out of your life?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...So you never told me off? You [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] want me out of your life?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And wait... If you were only here to check up on me... Does that mean you're not really dating Mark?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course not! That guy sucks!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh man...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We are `so` stupid!
nodes.text_bbcode: We are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] stupid!

nodes.text: Colt and Denni step forward and hug!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...I missed you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I missed you too, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: As touching as this little reunion is... We're still trapped in this stupid office, and we `still` don't have proof of what The Immortals are up to!
nodes.text_bbcode: As touching as this little reunion is... We're still trapped in this stupid office, and we [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] don't have proof of what The Immortals are up to!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... `Half` of that sentence is true. We might be trapped... But we've got proof.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... [color=#e23b3b][i]Half[/i][/color] of that sentence is true. We might be trapped... But we've got proof.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Percy smashed your camera!
Nick grins and holds up his hand. Cradled in his palm is a little electronic card.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... But he didn't smash the DigiVid card with the video on it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You palmed it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dude! Props!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, that `is` a great turn of events...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a great turn of events...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But I still don't know how we're going to get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Actually... I have an idea.
Denni glances at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't you remember? Last time...?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh! I get it! We should go out through the...

The next day, in Centerscore City Hall, several adults sit at a table with grim expressions on their faces.
At the head is Mayor Randy Oglethorpe, and in front of him are the Principals of Centerscore, Wilson, and Monarch Prep...
Principals Shapiro, Whitford, Dunkirk... I'm sure you all heard about what happened yesterday at Spartan Academy.
Complete insanity, by the sound of it!
I always `knew` there was something fishy happening at that school. Their SET scores were far too good to believe.
Do you know what the consequences are going to be?
Extreme, to say the least. All of the Spartan faculty has resigned in disgrace, and Headmaster Moriarty has been arrested for conspiracy to commit fraud.
Good! That guy totally sucks!
You know he made a pass at me once?
What about the students involved?
Well, the ringleader, Percival von Guttentag, was exiled back to Ichstenborg and permanently barred from entering the United States...
But the others are all off the hook.
What?! How can that be?
They were coerced into their criminal actions by their school's administration! No court in the world would prosecute them!
Bunch of little creeps...
With all due respect, Randy, is this really why you called us in here? To gossip?
No, I'm afraid I have a much more serious situation to discuss.
You see, once word of this reaches the Department of Education, Spartan Academy will lose its accreditation as an educational institution... And will be shut down.
As you can imagine, this will cause something of a student refugee crisis... And I will need all of you to help by taking in the boys of Spartan.
Whoa, whoa, with all due respect, Randy, Wilson is over-capacity as is. I just can't take in a bunch of random troublemakers...
And need I remind you that Monarch Prep is a `girl's` school?
This would only be a temporary measure... Until we can find other accommodations...
Sorry, but... We just can't do it...
Completely out of the question!
Principal Shapiro sighs deeply...
Centerscore will take them.
Oh, thank you, I can't tell you what a relief it is to hear that...
We don't exactly have a choice, do we? I'm not going to let a bunch of boys go without an education because their administrators were corrupt.
And you're comfortable taking all of them? Are you sure it won't cause too much of a disruption to Centerscore High?
What choice do I have, Mayor? My students are smart and resilient...
I'm sure they'll find a way to resolve any tensions!
...I hope.
Spartan merging with Centerscore?! That's crazy!

nodes.text: Previously on SHS, Denni infiltrated Spartan Academy to find the truth about its secret society, The Immortals.
When she learned that they were planning something big during The Cotillion, she pretended to be a Monarch Prep girl to get a date...
And that's when Colt discovered her!
And now...

nodes.title: A Spartan Love Story, Part 2
nodes.subtitle: The secret of The Immortals... Revealed!

nodes.text: Colt stands in the weight room of Spartan Academy, his mouth open in disbelief at the sight in front of him...
Denni, sitting on a bench, with Spartan jock Mark Backbutter's arm around her waist!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Colt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Colt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have `got` to be kidding me!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#e23b3b][i]got[/i][/color] to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I can explain...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really? You can explain what you're doing at my school with that guy's arm around your waist?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean, seriously, `that` guy? He sucks!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, seriously, [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] guy? He sucks!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: No, you suck, `Hades!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, you suck, [color=#e23b3b][i]Hades![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guys, please, this is a misunderstanding...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh, I think I understand just fine. This piece of trash here is some no-good ex of yours, and it just eats him up to see you flirting with a `real` man.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I think I understand just fine. This piece of trash here is some no-good ex of yours, and it just eats him up to see you flirting with a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] man.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No-good ex? Is that what you told him?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No! I didn't tell him anything!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, so I don't even warrant a mention, is that how it is?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I accepted that you wanted to date Tweed. I didn't get it, because who wants to date Tweed, but I accepted it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now I don't know if you're cheating on him or you two broke up or whatever, but for you to come to my new school, just to hook up with some toolbag...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's `not` what happened! Please, you've got to let me explain, I...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] what happened! Please, you've got to let me explain, I...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Relax, girl. I got this.
Mark stands up, getting right in Colt's face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen here, Shortpants, you do `not` want to go there with me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen here, Shortpants, you do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] want to go there with me...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh, I know exactly where I wanna go with you. So now how about you do us all a favor and stop bothering my date to the dance...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Or things might get real ugly up in here. You follow? `Punk?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or things might get real ugly up in here. You follow? [color=#e23b3b][i]Punk?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Mark shoves Colt, sending him staggering backwards!
Colt swings back around...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, that `friggin'` does it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, that [color=#e23b3b][i]friggin'[/i][/color] does it...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: What are you gonna do, huh? What are you gonna do?!
